confidence_rule: High = model probability > 70% AND originated fair price in 1.40-1.4286 (-250 to -233) AND both inputs official AND unique >=30-word prediction. Medium = priced but one gate missing. Low = priced with weaker/carried inputs. Unpriced = blank, flagged.

model.basketball: Expected score = mean(own points scored/GP, opponent points allowed/GP); normal margin sigma 12; total sigma 18; no home-court term.
model.ice-hockey: Expected goals = mean(own goals for/GP, opponent goals against/GP); normal margin sigma 2.0; total sigma 2.4; no home-ice term.
model.aussie-rules: Ladder-derived expected margin recorded by T63; normal sigma 18.5; total mean 74.5, sigma 20.
model.carried: Darts/rugby union/handball/baseball prices carried from data/92af340c/dataset.json (08:31Z).

price_policy: Fair decimal = 1/p, no margin, no clipping. American is derived from the rounded decimal. These are originated research lines, not bookmaker quotes.
